title: Five scoops of pre-workout right now 💀

through_line.name: the blue powder
through_line.prop_prompt: a heaped plastic scoop of bright electric-blue powder, a few loose grains falling from the edge, the scoop handle short and ridged
progression: a blue shimmer sliding down the tube walls
the blue liquid running thick and fast past Pipes

blocks.through_line_state: a blue shimmer sliding down the tube walls
blocks.sfx: a fizzing hiss, a liquid rush, a dry swallow
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: Pipes glancing up as a blue glow reaches him from above
CLOSE, low angle: Gut squinting upward into the blue light
MEDIUM, high angle: bright blue liquid sheeting down the tube walls past Pipes
CLOSE on the eyes: the blue reflecting in Gut's pupils

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Heads up. It's blue again.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Blue like what, exactly?

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Blue like pre-workout. She used five scoops.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: The label clearly says one scoop. One.

blocks.through_line_state: the blue liquid running thick and fast past Pipes
blocks.sfx: a rushing gush, a rattling vibration, a nervous creak
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Gut shouting upward, tube walls shaking around the words
MEDIUM, eye level: Pipes bracing as blue liquid floods past him
MEDIUM, high angle: the whole tube trembling, ripples running down its length
CLOSE on Gut's surface visibly buzzing

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Send it back up. Immediately.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: It's a liquid. It's already past me.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: My walls are tingling. Why is that?

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: That's the beta-alanine. It's normal.

blocks.through_line_state: the blue liquid pools and rises into a grinning shape
blocks.sfx: a carbonated fizz, a rising whoosh, a bright ding
shots: MEDIUM, high angle: blue liquid flooding across the cavity floor
CLOSE, low angle: the pool rising up and forming two wide eager eyes
MEDIUM, eye level: Gut backing into the far wall
CLOSE on the eyes: the blue shape grinning, vibrating in place

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: What is happening to the floor?

turns.speaker: preworkout
turns.line: Good morning! Let's move some weight!

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: It's four-forty. Nobody's moving anything.

turns.speaker: preworkout
turns.line: Three hundred milligrams. Caffeine. Let's go!

blocks.through_line_state: the pool is fizzing and creeping up the cavity walls
blocks.sfx: a phone tap, a low electrical hum, a rattling buzz
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: HQ standing very upright, faintly vibrating
CLOSE, low angle: HQ's tiny hand shaking against the phone screen
MEDIUM, high angle: the veins on the wall pulsing fast and bright
CLOSE on HQ's eyes, pupils enormous

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: HQ, my hands are vibrating right now.

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: You don't have hands.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Then what is vibrating, HQ?

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: Hold on. Let me look it up.

blocks.through_line_state: the blue reaches the far wall and keeps going
blocks.sfx: a rapid drip, a panicked squeak, a rising whine
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Buzz bursting into frame, eyes enormous
MEDIUM, eye level: Buzz bouncing in place, sweat drop flying off
MEDIUM, high angle: Gut turning away from Buzz entirely
CLOSE on the eyes: Buzz staring directly at the camera

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Buzz? Why are you up here?

turns.speaker: buzz
turns.line: We're at capacity. Nobody's listening to me.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Buzz, we have a bigger problem.

turns.speaker: buzz
turns.line: Six percent. Then five. Then four.

blocks.through_line_state: the blue has soaked into everything and stopped moving
blocks.sfx: a settling glug, one flat tone, a slow blink
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: the cavity finally still, everything faintly blue
CLOSE, low angle: Gut exhaling, shoulders dropping
MEDIUM, high angle: Liv hauling into frame behind Gut, unimpressed
CLOSE on the eyes: Gut's hope draining out in real time

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Okay. I think it's finally starting to fade.

turns.speaker: liv
turns.line: Not fading. Redistributing.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: What does that even mean, Liv?

turns.speaker: liv
turns.line: You'll be awake until Thursday.
